in_marathi.name: Bharadwaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of Bhrada
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharadwaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharadwaj is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Bharat' and 'Dwaj'. 'Bharat' means 'Bringer of joy' and 'Dwaj' means 'Flag'. Therefore, Bharadwaj can be interpreted as 'Son of Bhrada, who carries the joyful flag'. This name is often associated with wisdom, knowledge, and scholarship in Hindu mythology.
